body:
@ai-yang **Maintainer decision: TASK-4569001 and TASK-4569002 are approved. You may proceed with implementation and verification for Proposal #4568 under Design #4569.**

I reviewed both current TASKs against the Design already approved by @johnlanni in https://github.com/higress-group/higress/issues/4569#issuecomment-5418389633. They preserve the approved scope and verification approach, and the three non-blocking clarifications have been incorporated. This records explicit approval of the Proposal/Design scope and the remaining execution authorization:

- [TASK-4569001 — implementation](https://github.com/higress-group/higress/issues/4569#issuecomment-5419701760)
- [TASK-4569002 — runtime verification](https://github.com/higress-group/higress/issues/4569#issuecomment-5419703167)

Implementation ownership remains with you. You may update the TASK statuses and begin work; no further pre-start approval is needed within this approved scope.

Keep the agreed behavior: pause header-key requests only after successful Redis dispatch; return cached hits locally without upstream forwarding; resume misses, asynchronous errors, and empty values exactly once; continue on synchronous dispatch failure while preserving the existing side-effect ordering. Body-key behavior and cache formats remain unchanged.

As already required by the TASKs, refresh canonical main and the duplicate audit before implementation, then run the approved baseline/fixed verification through a real Envoy/proxy-Wasm path. Record exact revisions, commands, results, evidence URLs and hashes, including the documented timeout boundary and cleanup. Complete the implementation and verification TASKs before requesting PR review. If current main or runtime evidence requires a material departure from the approved Design, bring that specific change back for review.

This comment records the maintainer's explicit decision, prepared with Codex assistance; it is not a claim that implementation or runtime verification has already completed.
